sampling: Deterministic observed extrema and fixed regression/negative cases. Round-robin cases; seeded variant order by round.
routing: Dedicated target, READ_ACCESS, one reused driver/session, one in-memory DuckDB view connection.
cache: Initial observed after integrity audit and case selection on a running server. Warm varying and warm same-case measured separately.
timing: perf_counter_ns. Fully materialized rows. Neo4j includes transport and decoding. DuckDB executes and fetches locally. Hybrid total includes both and conversion. Separate Bolt summary timings are retained.
validation: Complete sorted JSON row multisets compared outside timed regions against normalized Parquet SQL.
statistics: Linear interpolation over sorted rank (n-1)*p; sample standard deviation. No p99 at this sample size.
errors: Sanitized error type and code retained, no automatic retries. Incorrect or unsuccessful timed queries fail acceptance.
plans: EXPLAIN and PROFILE/EXPLAIN ANALYZE run after timings and stored separately.

workloads.name: scoped_service_day
workloads.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT x.canonical_trip_id, x.route_id
FROM trip_selector_context x JOIN stop_times v ON v.trip_id=x.trip_id
JOIN active_services($day) active ON active.service_id=x.service_id
WHERE x.agency_id=$agency AND v.stop_id=$stop
AND ($route IS NULL OR x.route_id=$route)
AND ($direction IS NULL OR x.direction_id=$direction)
ORDER BY 1,2
workloads.cypher:
MATCH (a:Agency {source_id:$agency})-[:OPERATES]->(r:Route)
      -[:ROUTE_SERVES_STOP]->(s:Stop {source_id:$stop})
MATCH (a)-[:AGENCY_SERVES_STOP]->(s)
WHERE $route IS NULL OR r.source_id=$route
RETURN r.canonical_id,s.canonical_id ORDER BY 1
workloads.hybrid_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT x.canonical_trip_id,x.route_id
FROM canonical_ids r JOIN trip_selector_context x ON x.route_id=r.source_identifier
JOIN stop_times v ON v.trip_id=x.trip_id
JOIN canonical_ids s ON s.source_identifier=v.stop_id
JOIN active_services($day) active ON active.service_id=x.service_id
WHERE r.entity_type='route' AND r.canonical_id IN (SELECT unnest($route_ids::VARCHAR[]))
AND s.entity_type='stop' AND s.canonical_id=$canonical_stop
AND ($direction IS NULL OR x.direction_id=$direction)
ORDER BY 1,2

workloads.name: trip_service_visits
workloads.purpose: Ordered visits and service-day predicate including extended hours
workloads.sql:
SELECT v.stop_sequence,v.stop_id,v.arrival_time_seconds,v.departure_time_seconds,
       active.service_id IS NOT NULL AS runs_on_date
FROM trip_selector_context x JOIN stop_times v ON v.trip_id=x.trip_id
LEFT JOIN active_services($day) active ON active.service_id=x.service_id
WHERE x.canonical_trip_id=$id ORDER BY 1
workloads.hybrid_sql:
SELECT v.stop_sequence,v.stop_id,v.arrival_time_seconds,v.departure_time_seconds,
       active.service_id IS NOT NULL AS runs_on_date
FROM canonical_ids t JOIN stop_times v ON v.trip_id=t.source_identifier
LEFT JOIN active_services($day) active ON active.service_id=$service
WHERE t.entity_type='trip' AND t.canonical_id=$trip ORDER BY 1

workloads.name: calendar_exceptions
workloads.purpose: Calendar service on dates with additions and removals
workloads.sql: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_services($day) WHERE service_id=$service)
